hits.title: Joints, Camera, Action! Co-Generating 3D Motion and Video for Arbitrary Rigs
hits.abstract_snippet: Video generation models can now depict remarkably realistic motion. Yet it is unclear how to use this motion beyond pixels: to animate a specific 3D asset and replay the animation in its 3D scene. For instance, a video model can show a monkey jumping over a crossbar, but it cannot return that jump as replayable 3D motion placed in the 3D scene.
